blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan on Wednesday welcomed the bicameral conference committee’s finalized version of the proposed National Children’s Nutrition Act, saying it brings the promise of providing free and nutritious meals to Filipino schoolchildren closer to reality. “Malnutrition and undernourishment are not just health issues. They are also issues of education, poverty, and equal opportunities,” Pangilinan said. “Poverty should not prevent our children from having access to adequate and nutritious food,” he added. The reconciled measure consolidates Senate Bill No. 2272 and House Bill No. 9466, which seek to repeal and replace Republic Act No. 11037, or the […]...
